import qualified DA.Set as Set
import Daml.Script

import Synfini.AccountHierarchy.TestUtils

parentAccount : Parties -> Account

test_Agreement_partiesAndKey = withParties "'$ '"\\parties -> do

  Some stored <- queryContractId parties.eve agreementCid
  stored === agreement
  Some observed <- queryContractId parties.fred agreementCid
  observed === agreement
  hidden <- queryContractId parties.bob agreementCid
  hidden === None
  submitMustFail parties.alice do createCmd agreement
  submitMustFail parties.david do createCmd agreement
  let otherOwner = account with owner = parties.fred
  submitMultiMustFail [parties.alice, parties.david] [] do
    createCmd (agreement with account = otherOwner)

test_Agreement_requiresMatchingProvider : Script ()
test_Agreement_requiresMatchingProvider = withParties "'$ '"\\parties -> do
  let parent = parentAccount parties
      account = (beneficiaryAccount parties) with provider = parties.bob
      agreement = CustodyAgreement with parent; account; observers = Set.empty
  submitMultiMustFail [parties.alice, parties.david] [] do createCmd agreement

test_Agreement_updatesObservers : Script ()
test_Agreement_updatesObservers = withParties "'$ '"\\parties -> do
  let agreement = CustodyAgreement with
        parent = parentAccount parties
        account = beneficiaryAccount parties
        observers = Set.fromList [parties.fred]
  originalCid <- submitMulti [parties.alice, parties.david] [] do createCmd agreement
  submitMustFail parties.fred do
    exerciseCmd originalCid CustodyAgreement_SetObservers with newObservers = Set.empty
  submitMustFail parties.david do
    exerciseCmd originalCid CustodyAgreement_SetObservers with newObservers = Set.empty
  updatedCid <- submit parties.eve do
    exerciseCmd originalCid CustodyAgreement_SetObservers with
      newObservers = Set.fromList [parties.bob]
  old <- queryContractId parties.eve originalCid
  old === None
  Some updated <- queryContractId parties.bob updatedCid
  updated === (agreement with observers = Set.fromList [parties.bob])
  removedObserver <- queryContractId parties.fred updatedCid
  removedObserver === None
  finalCid <- submit parties.eve do
    exerciseCmd updatedCid CustodyAgreement_SetObservers with newObservers = Set.empty
  Some final <- queryContractId parties.eve finalCid
  final === (agreement with observers = Set.empty)
  agreements <- query @CustodyAgreement parties.eve
  agreements === [(finalCid, final)]

test_Role_authorizationAndRepeatedAgreements : Script ()
test_Role_authorizationAndRepeatedAgreements = withParties "'$ '"\\parties -> do
  let parent = parentAccount parties
      account = beneficiaryAccount parties
      secondAccount = acc parties.fred parties.charlie parties.bob
      role = CustodianRole with parent; observers = Set.fromList [parties.fred]
  Set.fromList (signatory role) === Set.fromList [parties.alice]
  Set.fromList (observer role) === Set.fromList [parties.bob, parties.charlie, parties.fred]
  key role === parent.id
  roleCid <- submit parties.alice do createCmd role
  Some storedRole <- queryContractId parties.charlie roleCid
  storedRole === role
  submitMustFail parties.alice do createCmd role
  submitMustFail parties.charlie do
    exerciseCmd roleCid CustodianRole_EnterCustodyAgreement with account
  submitMustFail parties.david do
    exerciseCmd roleCid CustodianRole_EnterCustodyAgreement with account
  agreementCid <- submitMulti [parties.charlie, parties.david] [] do
    exerciseCmd roleCid CustodianRole_EnterCustodyAgreement with account
  Some agreement <- queryContractId parties.eve agreementCid
  agreement === (CustodyAgreement with parent; account; observers = Set.empty)
  Some stillActive <- queryContractId parties.charlie roleCid
  stillActive === role
  secondCid <- submitMulti [parties.charlie, parties.fred] [] do
    exerciseByKeyCmd @CustodianRole parent.id CustodianRole_EnterCustodyAgreement with
      account = secondAccount
  Some second <- queryContractId parties.bob secondCid
  second === (CustodyAgreement with parent; account = secondAccount; observers = Set.empty)
  submitMultiMustFail [parties.charlie, parties.david] [] do
    exerciseCmd roleCid CustodianRole_EnterCustodyAgreement with account
  let invalidAccount = account with provider = parties.bob
  submitMultiMustFail [parties.charlie, parties.david] [] do
    exerciseCmd roleCid CustodianRole_EnterCustodyAgreement with account = invalidAccount

test_Request_acceptAndArchive : Script ()
test_Request_acceptAndArchive = withParties "'$ '"\\parties -> do
  let parent = parentAccount parties
      account = beneficiaryAccount parties
      request = CustodyRequest with parent; account
      role = CustodianRole with parent; observers = Set.empty
  Set.fromList (signatory request) === Set.fromList [parties.david]
  Set.fromList (observer request) === Set.fromList [parties.charlie]
  requestCid <- submit parties.david do createCmd request
  Some storedRequest <- queryContractId parties.charlie requestCid
  storedRequest === request
  hidden <- queryContractId parties.eve requestCid
  hidden === None
  submitMustFail parties.charlie do exerciseCmd requestCid CustodyRequest_Accept
  remaining <- queryContractId parties.charlie requestCid
  remaining === Some request
  _ <- submit parties.alice do createCmd role
  submitMustFail parties.david do exerciseCmd requestCid CustodyRequest_Accept
  agreementCid <- submit parties.charlie do exerciseCmd requestCid CustodyRequest_Accept
  Some agreement <- queryContractId parties.eve agreementCid
  agreement === (CustodyAgreement with parent; account; observers = Set.empty)
  archived <- queryContractId parties.charlie requestCid
  archived === None
  requests <- query @CustodyRequest parties.charlie
  requests === []

test_Request_cancelAndReject : Script ()
test_Request_cancelAndReject = withParties "'$ '"\\parties -> do
  let parent = parentAccount parties
      account = beneficiaryAccount parties
      request = CustodyRequest with parent; account
  cancelCid <- submit parties.david do createCmd request
  submitMustFail parties.charlie do exerciseCmd cancelCid CustodyRequest_Cancel
  submit parties.david do exerciseCmd cancelCid CustodyRequest_Cancel
  cancelled <- queryContractId parties.charlie cancelCid
  cancelled === None
  rejectCid <- submit parties.david do createCmd request
  submitMustFail parties.david do exerciseCmd rejectCid CustodyRequest_Reject
  submit parties.charlie do exerciseCmd rejectCid CustodyRequest_Reject
  rejected <- queryContractId parties.david rejectCid
  rejected === None

test_Request_invalidAccountDoesNotAccept : Script ()
test_Request_invalidAccountDoesNotAccept = withParties "'$ '"\\parties -> do
  let parent = parentAccount parties
      account = (beneficiaryAccount parties) with provider = parties.bob
      request = CustodyRequest with parent; account
      role = CustodianRole with parent; observers = Set.empty
  _ <- submit parties.alice do createCmd role
  requestCid <- submit parties.david do createCmd request
  submitMustFail parties.charlie do exerciseCmd requestCid CustodyRequest_Accept
  Some remaining <- queryContractId parties.charlie requestCid
  remaining === request
  submit parties.david do exerciseCmd requestCid CustodyRequest_Cancel

  let parent = parentAccount parties
      account = beneficiaryAccount parties
      request = CustodyRequest with parent; account

  Set.fromList (observer request) === Set.fromList [parties.charlie]
